TAVERN_EXPORT.GMOnly: Only a GM can export compendiums for Tavern Moot.
TAVERN_EXPORT.NoneChosen: Choose at least one compendium to export.
TAVERN_EXPORT.Done: Exported {packs} compendiums ({documents} documents) and {files} pictures, {size} MB. {left} files were left out (listed in the bundle and the console).

Dialog.Title: Export for Tavern Moot
Dialog.Hint: Choose the compendiums to export. You get one zip: drop it on the Foundry Export tab of Tavern Moot's Foundry Import widget, with a rules file for this system.

Option.PicturesHint: The pictures the documents use: portraits, icons, tokens, maps.
Option.CoreHint: Files under icons/ and ui/, which come with Foundry: check their licence before using them elsewhere.
Option.RemoteHint: Fetched from the web, which some sites refuse.
Option.TranslationsHint: The world's text in its language, for rules that read localisation keys.
